messages:
Sophie: Hey — hitting a weird combo of errors when running the JS SDK inside Cloudflare Workers (ESM build, published with wrangler). Calls sometimes fail with 'fetch is not defined' and other times with 'AbortController is not a constructor' when retries kick in. Anyone seen this? :thinking:

Sophie: stack snippet:
```
TypeError: fetch is not defined
 at callSDK (/worker/handler.js:45:12)
 at processRequest (/worker/handler.js:78:5)
```

Sophie: minimal repro (import + call):
```js
import { createClient } from '@redwood/inference'
const client = createClient({ apiKey: Deno.env.get('REDWOOD_KEY') })
await client.generate({ model: 'open-llama', prompt: 'hi' })
```

Devon: Can you confirm this is the ESM bundle from our SDK (not the CJS compat build)?

Sophie: yes, we ship ESM for Workers. repro app is using the published esm dist. wrangler publish + routes -> errors reproducible in staging.

Nate: Workers runtime doesn't have Node globals (no process, no Buffer, different crypto). Our retry/auth code paths assume AbortController + node-crypto in some bundles. Historically we only polyfilled the CJS build with a tiny shim. Looks like ESM got missed.

Nate: Quick workaround: add a tiny shim in your worker before importing the client:
```js
// worker entry
if (!globalThis.AbortController) globalThis.AbortController = class AbortController { constructor(){ this.signal = { aborted: false } } }
import './app.js'
```
(ugly but gets retries working)

Maria: FYI I opened a PR on sdk main to add a Workers-first ESM entry that avoids node APIs and uses WebCrypto + the native fetch/signal. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/sdk/pull/842 (adds AbortController fallback and crypto.subtle HMAC fallback).

Devon: Nice. Also note: if you're using the typed client, TS complains about Buffer types missing in Workers. We should update types to accept Uint8Array or make Buffer optional in d.ts.

Sophie: reported TS errors: "Cannot find name 'Buffer'" in generated types when `binary: true` is used in responses.

Maria: I'll add a small declaration file and widen the union in the PR. Plan: publish an esm-workers dist and add note in README about wrangler config (compatibility_date) and to avoid bundling node builtins.

Devon: One more gotcha — signing in auth: our current dev builds sometimes call node's createHmac path when the bundler tree-shakes differently. The PR forces WebCrypto for Workers so it will be deterministic.

Sophie: Awesome. I'll test the PR on staging tomorrow and report back. Thanks y'all. :raised_hands:

deploy-bot: deploybot: staging published at https://staging.example.workers.dev — build id bc123 (running current sdk from branch sdk-main-pr-842).

Sophie: verified — requests now hit and retries behave. Types still need the Buffer/Uint8Array tweak but everything else looks good.

Maria: will follow up with a tiny types-only patch and merge the PR after a smoke test.

Nate: filing follow-up issue to add a CI smoke job that runs a tiny worker sample each publish (catch regressions).

Sophie: thanks!
